title: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in Milan | 1970
content:
Bag One, John Lennon’s exhibition of erotic lithographs, opened on 20 February 1970 in Milan, Italy.

The lithographs, known collectively as Bag One, had been drawn by Lennon in 1969, and chronicled his wedding ceremony and honeymoon with Yoko Ono, and one of their bed-ins for world peace. The more explicit drawings were available only to “journalists, critics and special clients”.

The Bag One Portfolio was published as a limited edition of 300, and contained 14 artworks. Similar exhibitions had opened in London (15 January), Detroit (21 January), Long Beach (28 January), New York City (7 February), Amsterdam (7 February), San Francisco (13 February), and Toronto (14 February).
